mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_ID as memberId, m.NAME as name, m.EMAIL as email, m.PHONE as phone, l.LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, l.LICENSE_NO as licenseNo, l.SPECIALTY as specialty, l.INTRO as intro, l.OFFICE_NAME as officeName, l.CONSULT_FEE as consultFee, (SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0) FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') as avgRating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') as reviewCnt, a.SAVE_PATH as savePath FROM TB_MEMBER m INNER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT a ON l.LAWYER_ID = a.REF_ID AND a.REF_TYPE = 'LAWYER' WHERE l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND m.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY avgRating DESC, reviewCnt DESC

SELECT m.NAME as name, l.* FROM TB_MEMBER m JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LAWYER SET APPROVE_STATUS = #{approveStatus}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId}
